title: Ten upgrade paths and forty tiers
summary: Proposed official-game capability derived from the shared OS design; prototype presence is not production completion.
acceptance_criteria: All ten four-tier paths apply their intended changes, including tier-two transformations and tier-four apex behavior; crosspath rules are explicit.
Owner-approved official implementation and exact-revision validation evidence are required before promotion.

evidence.claim: Shared planned design in the prototype README; no delivery claim.
